instruction.text: Read the Second Amendment, adopted in 1791, about gun ownership and decide whether the statements below are true or false.

atoms.a: The Second Amendment gives the right to keep and bear arms to the people of the United States.
The amendment says the right to keep and bear arms can be easily changed by laws.

wrong.text: It says the right shall not be infringed.

atoms.a: The amendment argues that the right to own guns contributes to national safety.

instruction.text: Only a few states in the USA strictly regulate gun ownership. Read the arguments of someone, often a Democrat, who supports stricter gun control and fill the gaps.

atoms.b: “I advocate for stricter gun control, because in my opinion, carrying guns reinforces a ((++culture_of_violence)).”
“For example, there are a lot of ((++gun-related)) deaths, especially compared to other countries. ”
“Unfortunately, ((++accidents)) can happen when people use firearms.”
“Furthermore, it increases the risk of ((++mass)) shootings and endangers public safety!”

instruction.text: Read the arguments of someone, often a Republican, who is against stricter gun control and fill the gaps.

atoms.b: “I believe that owning guns is a matter of ((++personal_freedom)).”
“The ((Second_Amendment)) protects the right to own a gun.”
“Stricter gun control doesn't stop people from ((++committing)) crimes.”
